verdict.rationale: Square has a documented Payouts API (square-docs-17) which typically exposes payout and balance-transaction-like data, and general API/SDK access (square-gh-1/2) that an agent could call programmatically. However, there is no evidence of specific balance-transaction/reconciliation endpoints, no documented workflow linking payouts to underlying charges, and no example or hands-on confirmation of automated reconciliation. Missing for 10: documented balance-transaction endpoint details, explicit charge-to-payout linkage fields, and a reconciliation workflow example or third-party corroboration.
